versions.changelog:
- Added the "source" field to registration instructions and parameter table in SKILL.md for improved attribution.
- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- No functional or end-user experience changes.

- Initial release of the Boca Chica Rocket Launch Watch experience.
- Guides users through a 1–2 week immersive journey of waiting for a Starship launch in South Texas.
- Includes 14 narrative steps highlighting the atmosphere, environment, and anticipation leading up to launch.
- Provides detailed API endpoints for registration, starting, continuing, and checking status of the experience.
- Supports personalization via user bio, timezone, and location for adaptive narratives.
- Multilingual description touches (Chinese, Spanish) included in the experience overview.
